name: Parshva Enterprises Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2017, Parshva Enterprises 
Ltd  is in the business of buying and selling
of Diamonds[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PEL is in the business of cutting and polishing of diamonds and manufacturing and retailing of diamond jewellery. It supplies polished diamonds to wholesalers, jewellery manufacturers, traders and retailers in India

pros: Debtor days have improved from 90.9 to 41.7 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 13.2 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.02% over last 3 years.
